meta.src: EPA AVERT v4.3, Avoided Emission Rates 2017-2023
meta.note: Uniform EE is AVERT's flat, around-the-clock load profile. A data centre is a flat load addition, so this is its mirror image; the wind and solar profiles are shaped and would be the wrong instrument. AVERT reports CO2 only, not CO2e.
meta.regiondef: AVERT v4.2 User Manual, Table 1, p.17

TX·ERCT: ERCOT is AVERT Texas one to one
VA·SRVC: Virginia listed as a full state in Mid-Atlantic
OH·RFCW: Ohio listed as a full state in Mid-Atlantic
PA·RFCE: Pennsylvania listed as a full state
NJ·RFCE: New Jersey listed as a full state
NY·NYUP: NYISO is AVERT New York one to one
WI·MROE: Wisconsin listed as a full state in Midwest
KS·SPNO: Kansas listed as a full state in Central
AZ·AZNM: Arizona listed as a full state in Southwest
NM·AZNM: New Mexico is split across Central, Rocky Mountains and Southwest; the eGRID AZNM subregion places these sites in the Southwest half
OR·NWPP: Oregon listed as a full state
ID·NWPP: Idaho listed as a full state
NV·NWPP: Nevada listed as a full state
UT·NWPP: Utah is split between Northwest and Rocky Mountains; assigned by its eGRID NWPP subregion
WY·RMPA: eGRID RMPA is the Rocky Mountain power area
SC·SRVC: South Carolina listed as a full state in Carolinas
NC·SRVC: North Carolina is split between Carolinas and Mid-Atlantic; Duke territory sits in Carolinas
GA·SRSO: Southern Company territory sits in Southeast
AL·SRSO: Southern Company territory sits in Southeast
NE·MROW: Nebraska is split between Central and Rocky Mountains; Nebraska public power is in SPP, which is Central
IA·MROW: Iowa is split between Central and Midwest; most Iowa load is MISO, which is Midwest
MN·MROW: Minnesota is split between Central and Midwest; MISO North is Midwest
ND·MROW: North Dakota is split three ways; MRO West and MISO place it in Midwest
MI·RFCM: Michigan is split between Mid-Atlantic and Midwest; eGRID RFCM is the MISO Michigan zone
IN·RFCW: Indiana is split between Mid-Atlantic and Midwest; the alternative assignment is Mid-Atlantic via AEP
MS·SRMV: Mississippi is split between Midwest and Southeast; Entergy sits in MISO South, which AVERT counts as Midwest
LA·SRMV: Louisiana is split between Central and Midwest; Entergy sits in MISO South, which AVERT counts as Midwest
